chapters.title: Knowing Our Numbers
chapters.summary: Compare large numbers, understand Indian vs International place value systems, and estimate sums and products.
keyPoints: Indian System commas: 3, 2, 2 from right (e.g., 7,54,32,100 = Seven crore fifty-four lakh thirty-two thousand one hundred).
International System commas: every 3 digits from right (Millions, Billions).

workedExample.question: Insert commas suitably and write 87595762 according to the Indian System of Numeration.
steps: Start from the right and place the first comma after 3 digits: 87595,762
Place subsequent commas after every 2 digits: 8,75,95,762
In words: Eight crore seventy-five lakh ninety-five thousand seven hundred sixty-two.

quiz.explanation: 1 crore = 1,00,00,000 and 1 lakh = 1,00,000, so 100 lakhs equal 1 crore.

quiz.q: What is the place value of 7 in 4,72,890?
quiz.explanation: 7 is in the ten-thousands place, so its value is 70,000.

chapters.title: Whole Numbers
chapters.summary: Natural numbers along with zero form whole numbers. Explore properties on the number line.
keyPoints: Smallest natural number is 1; smallest whole number is 0.
Every natural number is a whole number, but 0 is not a natural number.

workedExample.question: Write the predecessor and successor of 10,000.

quiz.q: Which is the smallest whole number?

chapters.title: Components of Food
chapters.summary: Understand carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, dietary fibre, and balanced diets.
keyPoints: Carbohydrates and fats are energy-giving foods.
Proteins are body-building foods needed for growth and repair.
Deficiency of Vitamin C causes Scurvy; Vitamin D deficiency causes Rickets.

workedExample.question: How do you test a food sample for the presence of starch?
steps: Take a small quantity of the food item.
Add 2–3 drops of dilute iodine solution.
A blue-black colour indicates that the food contains starch.

quiz.q: Which nutrient mainly provides energy to our body?
quiz.explanation: Carbohydrates and fats are the primary energy-giving nutrients.

chapters.title: Who Did Patrick's Homework?
chapters.summary: A playful story showing how self-effort and persistence help Patrick achieve top grades.
keyPoints: Patrick disliked homework and preferred playing hockey and basketball.
Helping the tiny elf forced Patrick to look up dictionary words, solve maths, and read history.
Moral: Hard work and self-help are the true keys to success.

workedExample.question: Why did the little man grant Patrick a wish?
steps: Patrick saved the tiny man from his cat.
In gratitude, the elf promised to grant one wish.

quiz.q: Who actually did all the hard work for Patrick's homework?
quiz.explanation: Patrick looked up words and solved problems himself while guiding the elf.

chapters.title: वह चिड़िया जो (Vah Chidiya Jo)
chapters.summary: केदारनाथ अग्रवाल की कविता जो संतोषी, साहसी और प्रकृति-प्रेमी नीले पंखों वाली चिड़िया का वर्णन करती है।
keyPoints: चिड़िया को जुंडी के दाने, विजन (एकांत जंगल) और उफनती नदी से प्रेम है।
कविता हमें संतोष, साहस और प्रकृति से प्रेम करने की प्रेरणा देती है।

workedExample.question: चिड़िया को किन-किन चीज़ों से प्यार है?

quiz.q: चिड़िया के पंख किस रंग के हैं?
quiz.explanation: कविता में चिड़िया को 'नीले पंखों वाली' बताया गया है।
